steps.title: Configure app project and package identity
steps.description: Set up namespace com.bgtubeplayer.app and application configuration in build.gradle.

steps.title: Declare permissions and application metadata in AndroidManifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with background audio and notification permissions.

steps.title: Define UI layout color theme and application string resources
steps.description: Configure colors.xml, strings.xml, and styles.xml for dark video player theme.

steps.title: Create vector drawables for toolbar navigation and playback controls
steps.description: Design control icons including play, pause, back, forward, refresh, history, home, and exit buttons.

steps.title: Build main application layout with header controls and web container
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml layout structure containing dynamic player components.

steps.title: Design watch history UI layout and list item layout
steps.description: Create activity_history.xml and item_history.xml layouts for video history management.

steps.title: Implement data structure for watch history entries
steps.description: Create HistoryItem model class for storing playback titles, URLs, and timestamps.

steps.title: Implement local SQLite database helper for watch history persistence
steps.description: Create HistoryDbHelper to handle creation, retrieval, deletion, and clearing of history items.

steps.title: Implement custom adapter for history list view
steps.description: Create HistoryAdapter to bind watch history records to item layout with individual delete action.

steps.title: Implement background audio playback foreground service
steps.description: Create BackgroundAudioService with notification controls, wake locks, and media focus handling.

steps.title: Implement HistoryActivity for viewing and clearing watch history
steps.description: Build HistoryActivity controller to display history list and handle item selection/deletion.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity with background audio bridge and user navigation
steps.description: Build MainActivity controller to handle media controls, web interaction, and service bindings.

steps.title: Building BG Tube Player
steps.description: Compile and assemble the final APK binary for BG Tube Player.
